images.caption:
This is the View from the last stand cave on Isandlwana where after fight the Zulus and being pushed up the slope. The sole survivor of this group struggled up the base of the cliffs of Isandlwana, where he found a cave, he defended this, shooting or bayoneting all who came near, until several Zulus with rifles were gathered. They fired a volley into the cave and killed him.
This lone British soldier was the last white man to die in the camp at Isandlwana.
